Inside, wrapped in oilskin, lay a message written in blue ink: “When the foghorn sounds three times, turn the lamp toward the sea.” He laughed at first, because the lamp already faced the horizon. Then the foghorn groaned once. A second blast rolled across the water. On the third, the great lens shuddered and swung by itself. Far beyond the reef, a small green light appeared, blinking steadily. The keeper grabbed his coat and climbed down to the boat landing. The bottle’s paper had one final line: “Do not let them see the shore.”","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘停泊在雾里的巨船。高楼的窗灯零星亮着，清洁车缓慢驶过空旷街道，车轮声在楼群间回荡。便利店的白光映着守夜人的脸，早点摊刚升起第一缕热气。风吹动广告牌，也吹醒了树上的鸟。地铁仍在地下穿行，载着无人知晓的故事。此刻，喧嚣退到远处，城市露出疲惫而温柔的心脏，等待天边泛起微光。","w03":"- 想象一个任务。\n- 把任务交给一个更小的自己去完成。\n- 小任务完成后，再把结果组合起来，直到整个任务完成。"}
